title: Hazard County: Earthquakes
description:
In Hazard County, the ground can shake anytime. Preparedness is a way of life here, so when the shaking starts, the residents of Hazard County know what to do. Visit ready.lacounty.gov/earthquake for preparedness tips and resources.
